[[Count/Legends|Count]] '''Alde''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of the noble [[House Alde]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Alde co-funded the Republic's work on the [[Death Mark laser]], though the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] spy [[Aleyna Hark]] tagged the Count with the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon's]] targeting device and enabled the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Nefarid]] to kill him.
